name: billing-platform/test-payment-to-billing
description: Service integration test: Billing Service -> RabbitMQ -> Payment Service -> RabbitMQ -> Billing Service. Seeds an Invoice by publishing subscription.created.v1 directly, then drives the real invoice.created.v1 -> Payment -> payment.succeeded.v1 -> Invoice Paid -> invoice.paid.v1 chain, talking to the two real services over HTTP plus a test-bound queue.
